_readme: Places that stock Mrs. Samuel juice, shown on mrssamuel.com/stockists. Add one block per place inside "stockists". Required: name, type, area, address. Optional: url (their website or Instagram), phone, mapsUrl. type is one of: gym, salon, office, hotel, cafe, restaurant, shop, spa, other. The page joins the sitemap as soon as this list has one valid entry. Example: {"name": "Example Gym", "type": "gym", "area": "Lekki Phase 1", "address": "1 Example Street, Lekki Phase 1, Lagos", "url": "https://instagram.com/examplegym"}
